actions.name: resetDemo
actions.rules: No input and no Result. Dispatches RESET with a fresh createSeedDemoState(); dashboard asks confirmDemo before calling, but store itself does not confirm. State is then persisted by provider effect.

actions.name: addParty
actions.rules: Input name must trim non-empty; otherwise error 'Informe um nome demonstrativo.'. Creates new party ID, withDemoLabel(name), supplied type and active=true. No duplicate-name guard and no explicit length guard in method.

actions.name: toggleParty
actions.rules: No Result. Reducer toggles active when ID matches; unknown ID is a no-op. Existing references are not removed, so history remains.

actions.name: renameParty
actions.rules: Requires existing party, non-empty trimmed name and trimmed length <=160; otherwise 'Selecione um cadastro DEMO e informe nome de até 160 caracteres.'. Stores withDemoLabel(name), preserves ID and all references.

actions.name: addCategory
actions.rules: Requires non-empty name and code; otherwise 'Informe nome e código sintéticos.'. Normalizes code to DEMO- + payload without an existing DEMO- prefix, uppercase; duplicate normalized code case-insensitive yields 'Já existe uma categoria demo com esse código.'. Creates active category with new ID.

actions.name: addCenter
actions.rules: Requires non-empty name and code; otherwise 'Informe nome e código do centro DEMO.'. Normalizes code to DEMO- + uppercase payload; duplicate normalized code case-insensitive yields 'Já existe um centro DEMO com esse código.'. Creates active center with new ID.

actions.name: toggleCenter
actions.rules: No Result. Reducer toggles active when ID matches; unknown ID is a no-op. Inactive centers cannot be selected by new titles but remain in historical state.

actions.name: addProject
actions.rules: Requires non-empty name/code, active client party, and safe positive budget. Failure: 'Selecione um cliente DEMO ativo e informe nome/código.' or 'Informe um orçamento sintético maior que zero.'. Normalizes code; duplicate code gives 'Já existe um projeto DEMO com esse código.'. Creates progressPercent=0, status=ativo, new ID.

actions.name: setProjectStatus
actions.rules: No Result and no guard beyond TypeScript status union. Reducer replaces status when ID matches; UI asks confirmation before close/reopen, but direct store callers can dispatch immediately.

actions.name: setProjectBudget
actions.rules: Requires safe positive cents and existing project; failure text is 'Informe um valor DEMO válido para um projeto ativo.'. Implementation checks existence but not active status. Reducer replaces budgetCents; unknown ID is a failed Result.

actions.name: addTitle
actions.rules: Requires all three valid demo dates and none in closed period; compatible active party/category by direction; null or active project; safe positive amount; active center when explicitly non-null. Errors include 'Informe datas válidas para o título DEMO.', 'Uma das datas pertence a período DEMO fechado.', 'Selecione contraparte e categoria DEMO ativos e preencha a descrição.', 'O projeto DEMO precisa estar ativo.', 'Informe um valor sintético maior que zero.', and 'Selecione um centro de custo DEMO ativo.'. Creates manual-by-default title with DEMO label, sourceId null, fiscalDocument=nao_aplicavel and empty settlements. centerId uses nullish fallback to first active center or null.

actions.name: resolveDemoDocument
actions.rules: Requires an existing title with fiscalDocument=aguardando_demo; otherwise 'Este título não tem pendência documental DEMO.'. Sets fiscalDocument=demo_ok. No real document/file is accepted and no period guard is applied.

actions.name: settleTitle
actions.rules: Requires valid date, no awaiting document, exact full pending amount for field/interviewer source, title present, safe positive amount <= pending, and open settlement month. Errors include invalid date, document pending, exact-lot requirement, positive/non-exceeding balance, and closed period. Dispatches new settlement/bank IDs. appendSettlement creates one synthetic bank transaction; when fully settled, source interviewer/field item statuses become paga_simulada.

actions.name: addProvision
actions.rules: Requires valid dueDate, existing active project, active expense category, non-empty description, safe positive amount, and open due month. Errors: invalid date, 'Selecione projeto e categoria DEMO ativos.', 'Informe descrição e valor sintético positivo.', or 'O período demo está fechado.'. Creates prevista provision with titleId/cancelReason null.

actions.name: convertProvision
actions.rules: Requires today's Sao Paulo month open, provision status prevista, active project, active supplier, and provision due month open. Errors cover today's closed competence, closed project, missing provision/supplier, and closed due period. Creates a pagar title source=provision/sourceId=provision.id, issue/competence=today, due/amount/category/project copied; changes provision to substituida and stores titleId. Repeating conversion fails.

actions.name: cancelProvision
actions.rules: Blocks when provision due month is closed; requires non-empty reason and status prevista. Errors: closed period, 'Registre um motivo demonstrativo para cancelar.', or 'Somente provisão ainda prevista pode ser cancelada.'. Reducer sets status=cancelada and stores trimmed reason; no cancellation if status changed concurrently.

actions.name: createInterviewerBatch
actions.rules: Requires today's Sao Paulo month open, valid dueDate, unique itemIds, selected pending items all from the same supplied project, active project, and open due month. Selects first active supplier and cat-demo-field active category, falling back to first active expense category; otherwise fails with 'Cadastre uma contraparte e categoria de despesa DEMO antes de criar o lote.'. Sums exact item cents, creates payer title source=interviewer/sourceId=title.id, marks items em_lote. It does not require same item dueDate.

actions.name: payInterviewerBatch
actions.rules: Requires valid date, interviewer title, associated items in em_lote, untouched full pending balance, exact item sum equal to title amount, and open payment month. Otherwise 'O lote precisa fechar exatamente com a soma dos itens demo e não pode ter sido liquidado.' or date error/closed-period error. Appends full settlement/bank transaction and marks items paga_simulada.

actions.name: addFieldItem
actions.rules: Requires active project, active expense category, non-empty description, safe positive integer quantityHundredths, safe positive unitCents; invalid input yields 'Selecione projeto e categoria de despesa DEMO ativos.' or 'Informe item DEMO, quantidade e valor unitário válidos.'. Calculates amountCents with BigInt round-half-up formula and rejects unsafe result; adds pendente item. No period guard because item has no date.

actions.name: createFieldSheet
actions.rules: Requires valid date, active project, open sheet month, and at least one pending item in project. Errors include invalid date, inactive project, closed period, and no pending items. Automatically includes every pending project item, creates aberta sheet with exact sum and marks those items em_lote.

actions.name: approveFieldSheet
actions.rules: Requires today's Sao Paulo month open, an open sheet, open sheet date, active project, active supplier, active expense category, nonzero amount and exact sum of referenced items. Creates payer title source=field/sourceId=sheet.id, issue/competence=today, dueDate=sheet.date; sets sheet status=aprovada_demo/titleId. Errors cover open/closed state and unavailable project/vendor/category/sum.

actions.name: payFieldSheet
actions.rules: Requires valid payment date, approved sheet with title, non-empty itemIds, exact item sum equal to title amount, and open payment month. Appends full title settlement/bank transaction and sets sheet/items paga_simulada; invalid/unapproved/divergent sheet yields 'Folha demo não aprovada ou soma de itens divergente.'.

actions.name: cancelFieldSheet
actions.rules: Requires sheet date in open month and sheet status aberta. Errors cover closed period and 'Somente uma folha aberta pode ser cancelada.'. Removes the sheet entirely and resets referenced items to pendente; no cancellation reason/history is persisted. UI confirmation is outside the store.

actions.name: reconcileTransaction
actions.rules: Requires existing transaction, open transaction month, not reconciled, and non-empty classification. Errors cover closed period or 'Selecione uma transação aberta e sua classificação.'. Stores DEMO-labeled classification, reconciled=true, exceptionReason=null. UI offers four options but method accepts any non-empty string.

actions.name: markTransactionException
actions.rules: Requires existing open transaction, open month, non-empty classification and non-empty reason; otherwise 'Exceção DEMO exige transação aberta, classificação e motivo.' or closed-period error. Stores DEMO-labeled classification/reason, reconciled=true; this satisfies closePeriod pending check but leaves exceptionReason visible.

actions.name: closePeriod
actions.rules: Requires regex YYYY-MM with month 01..12 and year 2000..2099; rejects if any transaction date starts with period and is not reconciled or has no classification; rejects already closed. Errors: invalid month, 'Classifique ou concilie todas as linhas DEMO do mês antes de fechar.', or already closed. Adds period sorted. Direct call may close a month with no transactions.

actions.name: reopenPeriod
actions.rules: Requires valid YYYY-MM, period currently closed, and non-empty reason; otherwise invalid-period, not-closed, or reason error. Dispatches only REOPEN_PERIOD with period; the reason is validated then discarded and is not persisted. Removes period from closedPeriods.
